'''Eshkar Niin's holocron''' was a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] created by [[Darth Havok|Eshkar Niin]] during his time as an [[Imperial Knight]]. By [[137 ABY]], the holocron has passed into the hands of Niin's former apprentice, [[Antares Draco]].<ref name="Legacy (2006) 49" />
